# strremove

Deletes a string. *(version 4.67 or later)*

## Format

```ttl
strremove <strvar> <index> <len>
```

## Remarks

Deletes a specified number &lt;len&gt; of characters from the string variable &lt;strvar&gt; beginning at a specified position &lt;index&gt;(1-origin).

## Example

```ttl
s = '123abc456'
strremove s 4 3  ; '123456'
messagebox s s

s = '123abc456'
strremove s 1 3  ; 'abc456'
messagebox s s

s = '123abc456'
strremove s -1 3 ; Syntax error
messagebox s s

s = '123abc456'
strremove s 0 3  ; Syntax error
messagebox s s

s = '123abc456'
strremove s 9 1  ; '123abc45'
messagebox s s

s = '123abc456'
strremove s 9 2  ; Syntax error
messagebox s s

s = '123abc456'
strremove s 10 1 ; Syntax error
messagebox s s

s = '123abc456'
strremove s 4 0  ; Syntax error
messagebox s s
```
